headline: CrowdStrike to acquire Zscaler for $44 billion
summary: CrowdStrike agreed to acquire cybersecurity firm Zscaler for $44 billion, in a deal The Register says promises tighter integration between the companies' products. TechCrunch frames the deal as helping customers adopt AI agents, while The Register reports sysadmins fear it will bring higher prices and vendor lock-in.
